summary: m2l2a "Scuttling the U-529 - Naxos Prototype" is a pure disguise-stealth map: 1206 BSP entities, 51 ai_* actors of which 25 are DELETED at load by alarm_system_setup (converted to alarm-backup spawner templates), leaving ~25 live actors (13 in the $ai_alarm alarm-runner set, all forced type_attack=alarm + alarmthread=ai_alarm_alerted). Retail flow: spawn upstairs west room (-4816,-3880,-36) -> take uniform+papers1 in the locker room (trigger_useonce setthread=likeynorway; Norway-pair soldiers walk in and chat, then take patrol posts) -> descend past goatsbutt (elite sentry papers check L1, accept_thread disables punish triggers) -> naxos wing (3 scientist watchers guy1-3 doing wall-chart/table anim scenes; walking into $naxos trigger detonates the prototype and fires the ohnothenaxos1 bust) -> the pens "come to life" (crane/welders/hammer/crates/officer1 walk) -> swap papers1->papers2 in officer1's south office -> pass sentry2dude, the map's ONLY disguise_level=2 check -> east quay -> $endlevel (enter 2nd U-boat) -> missioncomplete m2l2b. Papers level is LEVEL-GLOBAL (level.papers -> level.m_iPapersLevel), checks are engine state machines (wait->papers->accept/deny/halt/enemy) driven per-actor by type_disguise (sentry/officer/salute/none; no rover on this map), and the 4-switch/9-zone alarm system spawns up to 4 backups per 15s in the zone with most players. The mod layer adds: objectives at load + toast threads, quiet hold-USE naxos sabotage with caught-in-the-act via guy1-3 cansee, blown-on-damage re-arm, cvar-gated unarmed stealth start (currently reverted, cvars forced 0), waitForEnemy watchdogs on the Norway pair, and the bug-1638/1639 engine-parity disguise gates.

mechanisms: ENGINE DISGUISE STATE MACHINE (openmohaa-hzm/code/fgame/actor_disguise_*.cpp): type_disguise selects the think - salute (Begin_DisguiseSalute: face + run anim/disguise_salute.scr, attack instantly if enemy undisguised or alarm), sentry (wait state State_Disguise_Wait runs anim/disguise_wait.scr, escalates to papers when dist^2*4 < maxDisguiseDist^2 or within 256u after 3s), officer (straight to papers), rover (unused here), none (InitDisguiseNone = NO disguise think at all: never salutes, never checks, just ignores disguised players). Papers state (State_Disguise_Papers, runs anim/disguise_papers.scr): player must 'use' the papers item (m_ShowPapersTime vs actor snapshot m_iEnemyShowPapersTime); no show for 12s -> ENEMY state (3s -> THINKSTATE_ATTACK); walking >256u mid-check -> HALT (1.5s -> ATTACK); shown papers with level.m_iPapersLevel < m_iDisguiseLevel -> DENY (runs disguise_deny.scr, 3s -> back to IDLE, re-challenge after disguise_period); shown with sufficient level -> m_DisguiseAcceptThread.Execute (BSP disguise_accept_thread label, fires BEFORE the accept anim) -> ACCEPT (runs disguise_accept.scr, 3s -> IDLE + think becomes THINK_DISGUISE_SALUTE permanently).

ENGINE DISGUISE VISION: EnemyIsDisguised() (actor.h:2159) = (per-actor snapshot m_bEnemyIsDisguised OR live player m_bIsDisguised) AND NOT m_bForceAttackPlayer AND thinkstate != ATTACK. Snapshot taken at SetEnemy: m_Enemy->m_bHasDisguise && (m_bIsDisguised || !CanSeeEnemy(0)). Cleared to 'I know he is fake' by NoticeShot, ConfirmEnemy, ConfirmEnemyIfCanSeeSharerOrEnemy (actorenemy.cpp:501/528, actor.cpp:10041) - so ANY confirmed enemy voids the disguise for that actor. actorenemy.cpp:446 deliberately KEEPS a disguised player as zero-threat enemy (enables papers checks). bug-1638: Player::Think m_bIsDisguised maintenance (player.cpp ~5479) now runs in every gametype behind g_coopDisgParity=1 - holster=disguised, draw=blown, per frame; script reads it via the is_disguised EV_GETTER (property syntax only). bug-1631: the maintenance IsAttacking veto requires GetCurrentThreat() > 0.

MOD AGGRO PIPELINE (coop_mod/aihandler.scr, working tree = bug-1639 state): coop_stealthBlocksAggro defers PER TARGET to engine is_disguised (disguised + no alarm + disguises enabled = block; undisguised = fair game same frame); no cvar window. canseeUndisguisedPlayers reads engine is_disguised per player + actor cansee(fov, sight). attackplayer/aihandler::attackPlayer sets the engine m_bForceAttackPlayer ONE-WAY latch (cleared only in Actor ctor) which permanently blinds that actor to disguises - scripts must NEVER latch a currently-disguised player. Second independent aggro path = alarmthread (ai_alarm_alerted), now disguise-guarded; third = the 7 anim/disguise_*.scr coop blocks, each of which threads attackPlayer + sentientIsSeen/Heard when the challenged player is engine-undisguised and visible.

ALARM/PAPERS GLOBALS: level.papers (script) IS level.m_iPapersLevel (engine, level.cpp:2094) - LEVEL-GLOBAL, not per-player: items.scr add_item papers_level1 sets 1, papers_level2 sets 2, remove_item either sets 0 (papers2pickup does remove-1-then-add-2, passing through 0). level.alarm (script) mirrors level.m_bAlarm - saluters and disguise thinks attack unconditionally while it rings; takeAllDisguises makes the loss PERMANENT in coop (level.coop_enableDisguises=false + per-player has_disguise cleared under a changeGameType-0 window) even though the alarm bell itself can be toggled off at a switch.

CARDGAME + SIT SYSTEM (global/cardgame.scr): drives ONLY the suckyfatty trio here ($cardgame table, target=suckyfatty, 3 targets -> cardgame3). bug-1637 fix replaced the never-firing 'level waittill spawn' with wait 0.5 in MP. Seated men are health=2 with stashed originalhealth, holstered, noticescale 1, type_disguise none; the mod sitthink adds a re-arming sit loop (only alarm/attack/pain break them out permanently, transient curious episodes are waited out 30s and re-seated, 2s-interval self-heal re-asserts seat pre-alarm) - but note sitthink runs only for $sit-marked spots (m2l2a has none; the trio is managed by cardgame3's own anim loop + checkresponse).

SCENE INTERLOCKS: level.peopletalking gates the intercom cycle (set by sentry1toggleon(!), likeynorway, norgirls, whattheydoin, sciencetalk-adjacent scenes); level.scienceinterupt (0 idle / 1 guy3 interrogation / 2 naxos event) aborts every scientist idle anim label; level.naxossequencetriggered makes the bust one-shot; game.m2l2sledgedead/wrenchdead/welderdead carry worker deaths to m2l2b; $wallsciencecontrol relay + level.wallscifinishcount sync the two wall scientists' anim pairs; easyskill (skill 0) halves health and triples accuracy spread on 17 named actors at load.
constraints_for_designers: THE LEDGER IS BINDING: .wolf/buglog.json bugs 1604-1639 (especially failed_attempts on 1631/1632), docs/OPEN.md, docs/proposals/m2l2a_stealth_master_plan.md + docs/proposals/research_m2l2a/ - no plan may re-propose a recorded failure without addressing why it failed.

MUST PRESERVE (live and user-approved): naxos hold-USE quiet sabotage + caught-in-the-act bust, objective toasts (coop_objToastStart + the two coop_obj_toast_all calls), blown-on-damage re-arm, and EVERY scripted anim scene - card trio, wall/table scientists + guy3 interrogation, welders, sledgehammer, wrenchman, crate carriers, crane/hangingflak cometolife beat, officer1 office walk, Norway-pair walk-in + patrol-post exit, whattheydoin, norgirls, specialmove easter egg, intercom + wavelaps ambience.

NEVER call attackplayer (or aihandler::attackPlayer) on a player the engine currently counts as disguised - m_bForceAttackPlayer is a one-way latch cleared only in the Actor constructor and permanently blinds that actor to disguises. Route aggro decisions through engine is_disguised (bug-1639 pattern).

NEVER swap type_disguise on an actor who may be INSIDE a disguise state. coop_paperPassAll's type_disguise 'none' fired 50ms into ACCEPT tears down the sentry think mid-anim and the none-think has no functions -> frozen forever (bug-1631). Any guard-retirement redesign must defer until his disguise think exits (state IDLE / disguise thinkstate left).

Papers are LEVEL-GLOBAL: one player picking up papers_level2 upgrades the whole team, and remove_item zeroes it for everyone. Any per-player papers design fights level.m_iPapersLevel and the engine check in State_Disguise_Papers directly.

An accepted papers check converts the actor's think to SALUTE (engine hardcode in State_Disguise_Accept) - designs assuming a sentry stays a sentry after accepting are wrong; on this map goatsbutt/sentry2dude are ALSO retired outright by coop_paperPassAll's type_disguise none.

alarm_system_setup FORCES type_attack='alarm' + alarmthread=ai_alarm_alerted on all 13 $ai_alarm actors, overriding BSP keyvals, and guy1-3/sledgehammer/welders get script alarmthreads (ohnothenaxos1/cower/weldinginterupt) - adding an alarmthread or type_attack to any of these actors clobbers a load-bearing assignment (and vice versa).

The 25 t15xx kreigsmarines DO NOT EXIST during play (deleted into spawner templates at setup). Encounter design must count only the ~25 live actors; alarm pressure is capped at 4 concurrent backups per 15s in the majority-player zone, and they self-remove when players leave.

Alarm switches are player-usable trigger_use and the master thread TOGGLES: a use while ringing silences the bell - but in coop the disguises are already permanently gone (takeAllDisguises ran on the first ring). Do not assume silencing restores stealth without new code.

The $naxos walk-in trigger is the LOUD path and objective2's only wake-up; the quiet path must keep the trigger-fire handshake (nottriggerable respected by script 'trigger' - re-arm before firing, coop_naxosQuiet set BEFORE the trigger so objective2 skips the bust). Model swap pair naxosnotsmashed/naxossmashed + antena pair is the retail-sanctioned destruction visual.
